findings.title: Save_manual_clockin.php missing idempotency enforcement
findings.description: The save_manual_clockin.php endpoint loads idempotency_helpers.php but never calls idem_begin(), idem_finish(), or idem_abort(). Multiple retries with the same idempotency key will create duplicate clocking records. Lines 42-98 process clock-in without any idempotency check.
findings.recommendation: Add idempotency check after authentication (line 42): extract key from HTTP_X_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY header or request body, call idem_begin($conn, $user['user_id'], 'clock_in', $idempotencyKey), return cached response if duplicate detected, call idem_finish() after successful commit (before line 98), call idem_abort() in catch block (after line 155). Follow the pattern in save_manual_clockout.php lines 52-64.

findings.title: UTC timezone validation not found in codebase
findings.description: Implementation Plan item #8 expected to find and fix timezone_validator.dart but no such file exists. Grep search for 'timezone' and 'UTC' validation logic found no time comparison between device and server. Time validation may be missing entirely, allowing learners to manipulate device clocks.
findings.recommendation: Either (1) implement new UTC time validation per PRODUCTION_READINESS_FIXES.md lines 281-306, (2) document that client time validation is out of scope and the system uses server timestamps only, or (3) locate validation logic if it exists under a different name.

findings.title: Sync coordination fixes documented but not implemented
findings.description: SYNC_COORDINATION_AUDIT.md identifies HIGH severity race conditions in persistent_sync_service.dart (_isSyncing flag never set), duplicate retry logic across two services (10-25 retry attempts for same request), and batch/individual clocking overlap. Audit provides concrete recommendations but none are implemented in code.
findings.recommendation: If these sync coordination issues are accepted for Phase 1-2 deployment per rollout strategy (PRODUCTION_READINESS_FIXES.md lines 565-574), document the acceptance explicitly. Otherwise, implement Priority 1 fixes from SYNC_COORDINATION_AUDIT.md section 7.

findings.title: Image upload resilience gaps documented but not implemented
findings.description: IMAGE_UPLOAD_AUDIT.md confirms no chunking for large batches, no resume capability for failed uploads, and 30-60s timeouts inadequate for 2G (single learner requires 24s). Audit provides concrete calculations and code examples but none are implemented.
findings.recommendation: If image upload limitations are accepted for initial deployment with chunking/resume planned for Phase 4 (PRODUCTION_READINESS_FIXES.md lines 558-561), document the acceptance explicitly. Otherwise, implement at minimum the timeout increases from IMAGE_UPLOAD_AUDIT.md section 8.1 lines 594-646.

approvedAspects: Diagnostic leaks completely removed from save_class_batch_clocking.php - no auth tokens, credentials, or system internals exposed in error responses
Batch clocking idempotency correctly implemented at two levels (batch-level and per-learner) preventing duplicate records
Clock-out idempotency properly enforced with idem_begin/finish/abort pattern preventing duplicate clock-out records
Structured logging implemented in offline_sync_queue_service.dart with JSON format, 7-day rotation, no PII/credentials
Logging standards document is comprehensive and actionable, clearly prohibits credential and PII exposure
Idempotency helpers implementation is production-ready with proper duplicate detection and 7-day expiration
